samples.text_head: Net Asset Value(s) | Company Announcement | Investegate Welcome Articles About Contact Us Help Home Companies Advanced search Archive Meetings Login Register Net Asset Value(s) AI Summary Close X Aberdeen New India Investment Trust reported undiluted ordinary net asset values as at close of business on 23 November 2026 of 880.40p excluding income and 880.87p including income, implying an income accrual of 0.47p (approximately 0.05% of NAV). The NAVs are calculated on an undiluted basis in accordance with AIC recommendations (fair-value/bid-price basis; debt at par). No diluted NAV, market price comparison, guidance, or additional performance commentary was provided in this announcement, leaving these NAVs as the primary available per-share metric for investors to compare against market price.
